_comment: When each shipped data file was actually captured from its source. Recorded explicitly because a file's modification time resets whenever it is copied, which made the app report the day it was deployed as the day the slate was pulled. UPDATE THESE WHEN YOU REFRESH A FILE -- the header showed Week 1 dates against a Week 2 slate because this was forgotten once.

slate.note: 670 players, 13 games, all Sunday 9/20 1:00-4:25pm -- one clean main slate with no primetime to filter. Statuses live at the pull: 578 active, 60 IR, 21 out, 9 questionable, 2 doubtful.

contests.source: DraftKings lobby, hand-transcribed; refreshed 11:41 AM from the open-contest screens
contests.note: 47 contests, 31 on the main slate, ~80 minutes before the 1:00pm lock. $75K Fair Catch, $50K Fair Catch and $20K Screen Pass had CLOSED since the first capture and are removed. Entry counts are a snapshot and move hard. Payout curves now verified for $100K Blind Side, $50K Blind Side and $75K Screen Pass — each reconciles to its advertised pool and place count exactly.

variance.note: Each player's own scoring spread. 359 of 670 matched on the Week 2 slate; the rest fall back to a flat positional multiple and are labelled inferred.

prior.note: 578 players. Flat 2025 average, blended against the in-season average at n/(n+3) so a single Week 1 game cannot carry a projection.

kalshi.source: Kalshi public read API, player prop ladders
kalshi.note: 178 players matched to the slate. Not used by the projection -- forward validation only, because no historical Kalshi data exists to backtest against.

usage.note: 390 players. Last game's snap share and touches -- the measured mispricing signal. Week 1 is complete for all 32 teams; week 2 covers only the Thursday game. Not used by the projection: it feeds the mispricing board only.
